notes.title: It's been a while...
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!  It has certainly been a while!

Although we have been silent for some time now, we’ve been here the whole time working very hard on what is now called “Rise of the Titan”!

This change from its former name “Titan Arena” was a direct reflection of what the game had evolved into over the last year.  We received a lot of great feedback from our fans and community after our kickstarter.  One of the common feedbacks was “not another wave-shooter”.  Although Titan Arena was never designed as a wave shooter, we realized how it was perceived as one.  Therefore, we decided to focus our efforts into reinforcing the narrative driven action-adventure design “Rise of the Titan” was always planned for.

In the coming weeks we will reveal more of what we’ve been working on through screenshots, animated gifs, and short video clips.  To start off, here are couple of our new environments.  Feel free to drop us a line and let us know your thoughts.
